items.title: Jonah Coleman: Finds end zone in Carolina
items.text:

items.title: Joe Milton: Throws for 169, runs for 64 in first start
items.text:
Milton completed 18 of 34 passes for 169 yards, no touchdowns and no interceptions in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the Giants. He also rushed nine times for 64 yards, ran in a two-point conversion and lost a fumble.
